pages.title: Dictionary of Design
pages.description: 113 art/design terms, illustrated with a small reusable abstract-vector visual grammar — “design of the external world.”

pages.title: Dictionary of Inner Experience
pages.description: 77 emotion/mood/existential terms, its own reusable visual grammar — “design of inner experience.”

pages.title: The Logic of a Prompt & Life
pages.description: Writing a good prompt uses the same logic as clear thinking in everyday life: premises, scope, definitions, constraints, a goal, evidence and tests. Twenty-one parts of a prompt in seven logical families, with a live prompt builder and a spot-the-missing-piece game. Also in Spanish, Russian, Chinese and Japanese.

pages.title: Planck to Horizon — every size in nature
pages.description: A continuous zoom through 62 steps of ten, from the Planck length to the observable universe, with a mass–size map of everything in between: 175 sourced objects, where sizes meet, where a human stands, and what physics rules at each scale.

pages.title: Universal Waves
pages.description: Master index of every wave family in nature: mechanical, electromagnetic, matter, plasma, gravitational, chemical, biological, information, astronomical, plus the shared mathematics.

pages.title: Waves — Sound, Light & Vibration
pages.description: Sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves.

pages.title: Music Is Mathematics
pages.description: String physics, harmonics, equal temperament, digital audio, radio, cosmic resonance, and a nine-tool audio lab.

pages.title: Perception — Visual & Auditory Illusions
pages.description: Visual and auditory illusions as evidence for the brain as an inference engine, not a recorder.

pages.title: Electronics — Components to Microcontrollers
pages.description: Resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors, logic gates, the 555 timer, and a semiconductor-physics deep dive; six interactive demos.

pages.title: Radio Communications
pages.description: Frequency, modulation, propagation, spacecraft links, and spectrum management; a real FFT SDR waterfall.

pages.title: Media Servers
pages.description: Generative art, real-time rendering, GLSL shaders, projection mapping, and signal processing.

pages.title: Media Servers II
pages.description: A real compiled GLSL shader, 3D projection mapping, Gerstner ocean waves, Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, and curl-noise flow fields.

pages.title: Photolithography — Printing With Light
pages.description: From Niépce's 1827 bitumen heliograph to 8 nm EUV: resist chemistry, the process step by step, spin coating, an exposure simulator, shrinking a mask through a microscope, and any picture as a printable dot matrix — with safety notes.

pages.title: Password & Passphrase Generator
pages.description: Client-side only, Web Crypto API, canonical BIP-39 wordlist, no network calls.

pages.title: Life in Weeks
pages.description: Enter a date of birth: every week lived on a 100- or 120-year grid, the world-average life expectancy marked, exact calendar counts and labelled body averages. Nothing leaves the browser.

pages.title: Audio Synths
pages.description: Hub for every sound instrument: SoundOS (desktop only), Pulse Train — Stage II (mobile & desktop), the Node Database, the homepage live rig and the archive.

pages.title: Patch Bay
pages.description: A real, playable generative modular synthesizer — drag real patch cables between Web Audio modules.

pages.title: Signal Chain
pages.description: A universal-node synth: one universal in/out jack instead of typed cables, nine chainable pedal-style units.

pages.title: Pulse Train
pages.description: Precision/microsound synthesis in the minimal/glitch lineage of Ryoji Ikeda, Alva Noto, and Raster-Noton.

pages.title: Pulse Train II
pages.description: A ten-unit rack expanding Pulse Train with a second Tone, an infinite-freeze delay, a comb resonator, and convolution reverb.

pages.title: Pulse Train — Stage
pages.description: The ten-unit engine restyled for live play, with eight interval-math tuning presets and a fullscreen Stage mode.

pages.title: SoundOS
pages.description: A browser modular synthesizer builder: patch nodes with cables, hit Generate and it oscillates continuously like a powered-on rack, with per-node record-and-loop of knob moves.

pages.title: Pulse Train — Stage II
pages.description: Thirteen units across five labeled groups, with a patchable LFO carrying its own modulation scale per destination.

pages.title: Node Database
pages.description: Every node in Pulse Train — Stage II, explained three ways: software DSP, underlying math, and real hardware.

pages.title: Video Synths
pages.description: Hub for every live image-making piece: four WebGL installation studies and five visual instruments.

pages.title: Point Cloud Scan
pages.description: Procedural 3D point-cloud scans (terrain, vaulted nave, tree, knot, or your image as depth) swept by a scanning plane and eroded by a noise-field decomposition front.

pages.title: Displacement Field
pages.description: Hidden-line sheet displaced by fractal noise, wave interference, an image, your camera, or a live microphone spectrogram.

pages.title: Latent Flow
pages.description: Up to a million GPU particles advected by a divergence-free ABC fluid flow, morphing between sculptural forms.

pages.title: Data Matrix
pages.description: Pixel-exact black-and-white data composition: barcodes, binary fields, waveform plots and a perspective data plane, with optional sine/click sound.

pages.title: Photogrammetry Scan
pages.description: A real Structure-from-Motion reconstruction (a downtown high-rise block, 225k coloured points, 251 solved cameras) to orbit or fly along its capture path, with scan-plane and decomposition effects; loads your own Meshroom .abc or .ply.

pages.title: Flock
pages.description: Craig Reynolds' boids in 3D: starlings or sardines that flock from separation, alignment and cohesion alone; hunt, lure or obstruct them, switch between metric and nearest-k neighbours, and see every rule as a coloured force in the Vectors layer.

pages.title: Light Grid
pages.description: Black-and-white light installation study: a lattice of squares and circles that rotate, breathe, outline, run as bars, flip in counterphase and ripple into moiré rings on a travelling wave; signed-distance fragment shader with full controls.

pages.title: Cone
pages.description: Laser beams on rotating mounts sweep cones, cylinders and fans through a hazy black room: volumetric single-scattering study in red, with a white key beam, grain, slow phases and optional FM sound.

pages.title: Erosion
pages.description: A real photogrammetry scan of a city block (225,000 points) falling apart along a release front, pooling like liquid at the ground and rebuilding; four release patterns.

pages.title: Ring
pages.description: One laser circle drawn over and over in haze, leaving a fading trace on a photosensitive wall; rings tilt in space, and sound (internal or microphone) holds them or breaks them into fragments.

pages.title: Light-Day
pages.description: A radio pulse leaves Earth every hour and travels to Voyager 1 at the speed of light, in true proportion; on 18 November 2026 Voyager 1 is one light-day away. Light time solved from JPL Horizons ephemerides.

pages.title: Chirp
pages.description: Two black holes spiral in; their gravitational waves leave as tightening spiral lines. LIGO's GW150914 data, its numerical-relativity waveform, the simple formula's match with the data, and the chirp as sound.

pages.title: Plume
pages.description: A rocket exhaust with shock diamonds computed from the nozzle area ratio and the air at each altitude: isentropic flow, US Standard Atmosphere 1976, Prandtl–Meyer turn, Schmucker separation.

pages.title: Re-entry
pages.description: A capsule in the plasma it makes, driven by a step-by-step entry simulation: Sutton–Graves heating, the shield's blackbody glow and Billig's bow shock. Apollo 11, Stardust, Apollo 7.

pages.title: Orbit Loom
pages.description: A sun-synchronous satellite weaves its ground track one orbit at a time until the pattern repeats; J2 rates, a repeat-orbit solver checked against Landsat and Sentinel-2, live swath coverage.

pages.title: Relic
pages.description: The real Planck SMICA map of the cosmic microwave background drawn from its HEALPix pixels: add our motion's dipole, blur to COBE's beam, read the map's statistics, hear its power spectrum.

pages.title: Rind
pages.description: Map projections as an instrument: sixteen projections, re-centre any of them, drag the land through the distortion, a globe beside the map, Tissot circles, area and angle heat maps, great circles and rhumb lines, carry Greenland to the equator; a 12-stop guided tour.

pages.title: Threshold
pages.description: Contour bands of a moving noise field in black, grey and red: paint pressure, trigger accumulate, saturate and release events, and play a drone driven by the same numbers.

pages.title: Chain
pages.description: Video-feedback instrument built from visible, reorderable passes (transform, blur, displace, melt, threshold, edge, kaleidoscope, mirror, hue, fade), each with its explanation and GLSL line.

pages.title: Sensor
pages.description: Forty-eight strata of fine lines bent by a hidden data stream (harmonic tide model, machine log, your typing, your hand); hover to reveal the raw signal; eight-voice sound.

pages.title: Upside Down
pages.description: Light beams fall onto a simulated water surface and continue below it, refracted by Snell's law and mirrored by ripples you make; each beam is a voice detuned by the waves.

pages.title: Palette Synth
pages.description: A live cosine-gradient color instrument — twelve knobs generate a full smooth palette in real time.

pages.title: Additive Wave Sculptor
pages.description: Eight-harmonic Fourier synthesis, playable as real audio via a Web Audio PeriodicWave.

pages.title: Lissajous / Harmonograph Plotter
pages.description: Two axes, each a two-term sine sum, plotted against each other with amplitude decay.

pages.title: Audio-Reactive Reaction-Diffusion
pages.description: The Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion chemistry, driven live by sound.

pages.title: Spectral Visualizer
pages.description: A real-time FFT spectrum analyzer and waveform oscilloscope driven by microphone, file, or internal oscillator.

pages.title: Complex-Plane Fractal Mapper
pages.description: A Mandelbrot/Julia explorer colored with Palette Synth's own gradient formula.

pages.title: Node-Based Software Development
pages.description: An interactive field guide to visual/node programming, including a working drag-and-connect node-graph playground.

pages.title: The Verification Field Manual
pages.description: A practical handbook for finding, verifying, and preserving information across the web and academic archives.

pages.title: Blockchain Infrastructure
pages.description: Distributed systems, consensus, cryptography, smart contracts, and DAOs — neutral and non-speculative, with real crypto.subtle demos.

pages.title: Anatomy Explorer
pages.description: An interactive 3D human body built from 1,635 real BodyParts3D structures — skeleton, muscles, organs, vessels, brain — with blood-flow and nerve-signal pulses.

pages.title: World Calendar Explorer
pages.description: Convert any Gregorian date across 28 historical and contemporary calendar systems, with verified conversion math.

pages.title: Country Comparison Atlas
pages.description: A living global atlas of 205 countries and territories, compared side by side across sourced core statistics.

pages.title: US States Atlas
pages.description: Compare any two U.S. states on a tile grid or map, plus a government view of party control across four layers.

pages.title: The Ark of Consciousness
pages.description: Logos, recording, learning, and the passage to the next layer of reality — an essay at the boundary of philosophy, cognitive science, information theory, machine learning, biology, and biblical theology.

pages.title: Heavy Machinery: The Blueprint
pages.description: An interactive comparator ranking 20 real machines by height, weight, power, and capacity, with human-scale equivalents.
